Previous
Go to the previous frame of the current scene.
tip.frmFW:
Next
Go to the next frame of the current scene.
tip.frmFWEnd:
Last
Go to the last frame of the current scene.
tip.scnRWEnd:
First Scene
Go to the first scene.
tip.scnRW:
Previous Scene
Go to the previous scene.
tip.scnFW:
Next Scene
Go to the next scene.
tip.scnFWEnd:
Last Scene
Go to the last scene.
tip.play:
Play/Stop 
Click to Play and Stop your movie.
tip.undo:
Undo/Redo
Undo the last thing you did!  Redo what you undid!
tip.ccp:
Cut, Copy, & Paste Tools
Get rid of, copy, paste, or move things from one place to another.
tip.port:
Portfolio
Start a new movie, open an existing movie, and save your work!
tip.book:
Play in Theatre
Watch your movie in the theatre!
tip.map:
Source Code
View the source code for this project on Github.
tip.1back:
Scene Choices
Choose from many different scenes!
tip.1view:
Camera Angles
Choose a different camera view of the current scene.
tip.p3rmbk:
Remove Everything Before
Remove everything before the current frame in the current scene.
tip.p3rmfw:
Remove Everything After
Remove everything after the current frame in the current scene.
tip.1scen:
Scene Organizer
Change the scene order and add transitions.
tip.2prop:
Props 
Add props like furniture and cars!
tip.2splt:
3D Words
Create 3D words that can spin and move!
tip.2comp:
Reposition
Reposition an actor, prop, or 3D word and its path from the current frame on.
tip.2cont:
Resume Last Action
Continue the last action an actor, prop, or 3D word used.
tip.2acts:
Actions
Make the actor, prop, or 3D word you click move!
tip.2cost:
Costume Changer
Change the way the actor, prop, or 3D word you click looks!
tip.2rot:
Rotate Tools
Change the direction an actor, prop, or 3D word faces.
tip.2xy:
Up & Down
When this is "on," you can move an actor, prop, or 3D word up and down (instead of near and far).
tip.2zero:
Fall Through Ground
When this is "on," an actor, prop, or 3D word can move through the ground surface.  Otherwise, it can't.
tip.2tran:
Size Tools
Resize an actor, prop, or 3D word!
tip.2soon:
Synchronize
Change when an actor, prop, or 3D word gets to a particular location.
tip.2bio:
Talent Book
Gives you the scoop on all the actors you can use in your movie!
tip.3note:
Music
Attach music to a background.
tip.3sing:
Play Once
Attaches the sound you choose and plays it one time.
tip.3loop:
Loop
Attaches the sound you choose and plays it continuously.
tip.3ear:
Listener
Listen to, remove, or change the volume of individual sounds.
tip.3rpt:
Action Matcher
Attaches a sound to the current action position.
tip.1note:
Wait For Sound to End
Pause the movie action until a sound is finished.
tip.4new:
Word Box
Create a box where you can type your movie story or credits.
tip.4ins:
Insertion Point
Move, resize, or change words in a word box.
tip.4font:
Letters
Change the way your letters look!
tip.4bold:
Styles
Make words stand out with styles like bold or italic.
tip.4size:
Letter Size
Change the size of your letters.
tip.4colr:
Letter Color
Change the color of your letters.
tip.4back:
Background Color
Change the background color of a word box.
tip.4scrl:
Scrolling or Non-Scrolling Words
Change a word box so that words scroll or stay still!
tip.p3cut:
Cut
Cut what you click.  If you want, you can paste it in another location.
tip.p3copy:
Copy
Copy what you click so that you can paste it in another location.
tip.p3cppt:
Copy Path
Copy the path of the actor, prop, or 3D word you click.
tip.p3past:
Paste
Paste whatever you most recently cut or copied at the place where you click.
tip.p3rmac:
Remove 3D Object
Remove the actor, prop, or 3D word you click from the current scene.
